# HDFC Bank Ltd (HDFCBANK) - Investment Note

## RECOMMENDATION SUMMARY
**HOLD** with target price of ₹1,820 (4.7% upside from current ₹1,737.95). Limited near-term upside following post-merger integration challenges, though franchise quality remains intact.

## INVESTMENT CASE

• **Best-in-class asset quality with diversified portfolio**: GNPA at 1.24% (ex-agri: 0.97%) and NNPA at 0.40% with 70% provision coverage ratio demonstrates superior underwriting standards. Balanced retail mix (53% of AUM) across mortgage (30%) and retail assets (23%) provides portfolio stability.

• **Sustained profitability and capital strength**: Strong 21% profit CAGR over five years with ROE at 13.9% and ROA at 1.92%. Fortress balance sheet with CAR at 19.9% and CET1 at 17.4% provides ample headroom for growth and shareholder returns (23.3% dividend payout).

• **Operational efficiency leader**: Cost-to-income ratio of 39.2% remains among the best in private banking. NIM at 3.35% despite post-merger CASA pressure (34%) reflects pricing power and strong liability franchise with ₹3 trillion deposit growth (12.2% YoY).

• **Consistent growth momentum**: Median sales growth of 16.4% over 10 years with current loan growth at 11.9% and deposit growth at 11.6% demonstrates ability to scale while maintaining quality through credit cycles.

## KEY RISKS

• **CASA normalization pressuring margins**: CASA ratio at 34% remains below historical levels post-HDFC Ltd merger. Further compression could impact NIMs and profitability if rate cycle remains adverse or competition for deposits intensifies.

• **Elevated contingent liabilities**: ₹27.8 lakh crore in contingent liabilities (primarily guarantees and derivatives) requires monitoring. Low interest coverage ratio suggests potential vulnerability to rate volatility.

• **Valuation leaves limited margin of safety**: Trading at 2.50x book value with only 4.7% upside to target. Rich multiples vulnerable to derating if growth disappoints or asset quality deteriorates from current benign levels.

## VALUATION

Target price of ₹1,820 implies 2.6x FY26E P/B, justified by superior ROE profile and franchise quality. However, current 2.50x book already prices in near-term growth prospects. Maintain HOLD given limited upside; initiate/add on pullback toward 2.0-2.2x book value where risk-reward becomes more attractive. Quality franchise warrants premium valuation, but await better entry point for fresh deployment.

---
*Market Cap: ₹13.2 trillion | Sector: Financial Services*
